entry.title: Heterogeneous Agent Monetary Transmission Under Sovereign Debt Maturity Walls
entry.summary:
We solve a continuous-time HANK model with endogenous term-premia and non-linear fiscal reaction functions across 38 OECD and emerging sovereign bond markets. When short-term refinancing exceeds $28\%$ of GDP, a $100\text{ bps}$ policy tightening induces fiscal dominance spillovers that attenuate disinflation by $42\%$ unless paired with liquidity-draining repo corridors.

Source: NBER Working Papers / arXiv econ.EM · Tags: #monetary-policy #macroeconomics #econometrics
